title: Don't Say "I'm Fine" – Say This Instead #shorts
description:
Don't say "I'm fine". Say this instead:
• Not bad! (casual, with friends)
• Pretty good, thanks. (everyday and friendly)
• Can't complain. (relaxed)
• Couldn't be better! (when you're really happy)
• Hanging in there. (after a hard week)

Which one will you try today? Write it in the comments.
